--- title: "Curriculum Vitae" pagetitle: "CV" description-meta: "Curriculum vitae of Antoine Vernet, Associate Professor in Management at UCL: positions, education, publications, grants, teaching, and service." engine: knitr cv: pdf: "antoine-vernet-cv.pdf" title-block-banner: "#003249" --- ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ::: Antoine Vernet is an Associate Professor in Management at the [Bartlett School of Sustainable Construction](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/bartlett/construction/), University College London. He studies social networks, organizational design, and strategy. The full CV is available to download and view below. ## At a glance **Current position** - Associate Professor in Management, Bartlett School of Sustainable Construction, UCL (2020–present) - Director, Centre for Organisational Network Analysis (CONA) - Deputy Research Director, Bartlett School of Sustainable Construction (from 2023) **Previous positions** - Lecturer in Management, Bartlett School of Sustainable Construction, UCL (2017–2020); Director of the MSc Strategic Management of Projects (2019–2024) - Research Associate, Imperial College Business School (2010–2017) **Education** - PhD in Sociology, Université Paris-Ouest (Paris Nanterre), 2010 - MA in Sociology (2005) and BA in Sociology and Economics (2004), Université Paris-Ouest - Senior Fellow of the Higher Education Academy (2022) **Selected publications** - [In women we trust? Gender-status mismatch and trust in professional networks](/research/articles/song-vernet-in-women-we-trust/), *Gender & Society* (2022) - [Examining the generalizability of research findings from archival data](/research/articles/deliosetal/), *PNAS* (2022) - [How does energy matter? Rural electrification, entrepreneurship, and community development in Kenya](/research/articles/vernet-khayesi-george-george-bahaj/), *Energy Policy* (2019) - [Revisiting the small-world phenomenon: Efficiency variation and classification of small-world networks](/research/articles/opsahl-vernet-alnuaimi-george/), *Organizational Research Methods* (2017) - [Adoption readiness in service innovation: The case of digital money](/research/articles/thomas-vernet-gann/), *Industry and Innovation* (2016) See the [research page](/research/) for all publications and working papers. **Selected grants and awards** - Best Reviewer Award, Academy of Management, Strategic Management division (2022) - Nominated for the Best Paper Award, Academy of Management, OMT division (2023) - Collaborator, *Network and competition effects in the diffusion of innovation in the NHS*, funded by the Health Foundation (£450,000, 2015–2018) **Teaching** Data analytics, social network analysis, and organisational design on UCL's MSc programmes in project and enterprise management. See the [teaching page](/teaching/) for details. **Service** Editorial board member, *Project Management Journal*. Ad hoc reviewer for journals including *Academy of Management Journal*, *Organization Science*, *Research Policy*, and *Social Networks*. ## Full CV ```{=html}
